text:
Mackie Samoskevich won a Stanley Cup with Florida in 2025 and has started his Seattle career with six goals in 15 games, already halfway to last season's total in Florida. The goals have mattered, too: his wins-added number ranks 87th of 515 skaters.

The shooting is the obvious caution. Six goals on 2.6 expected is a 22% shooting rate, against 7% last season. Our numbers flag him as due to cool, and his points per 60 are well above his usual range.

Underneath the goals there is a useful player. Evolving-Hockey had his team creating more chances with him on the ice (90th percentile among forwards) and credited him with three goals of value from drawing penalties alone. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 70% of his exits leaving the zone with possession and more than half his shots coming off the rush. Seattle's 5v5 numbers are better with him than without him, even if the team is under water overall.

He plays about 15 and a half minutes a night. If the goals slow, the transition game is what keeps him in that role.
headline: Samoskevich is finishing at a rate that won't last
